name: arabic-name-matching
description: Match Arabic personal names between lists, such as a roster against attendance sign-ins. Handles spelling variants, shortened and Latin-script names, links each person's submissions, and asks before applying doubtful matches.

interface.shortDescription: Match Arabic names across rosters and sign-in sheets
interface.longDescription: Finds the people on a roster among form exports, allowing for the many ways Arabic names are written, and writes an attendance workbook. Doubtful pairs are put to you instead of guessed.
defaultPrompt: Match this roster against the sign-in sheets and show who attended each session
Who on this list never attended, and who came without being registered?
Find these withdrawn students in the attendance files
